scenario: Full quarantined workspace backup with all ancestral archives and continuing live source

stages.label: active-workspace-with-two-archived-hops
stages.explanation: The active R4 workspace has two complete ancestral archives and a normally loadable release.

stages.label: current-authorization-and-source-boundaries
stages.explanation: Only the live imported workspace and its current administrator may authorize a new full backup.

stages.label: full-backup-captures-current-state-and-all-archives
stages.explanation: The completed full bundle contains quarantined R4 records and both unchanged fenced ancestral archives.

stages.label: live-authors-continue-after-capture
stages.explanation: Three live author jobs and one new composition use current source grants after the full backup.

stages.label: fresh-source-decisions-and-acceptance
stages.explanation: Four fresh decisions authorize revision 5 only in the live source; the full backup still describes R4.

stages.label: later-revocation-does-not-rewrite-captured-history
stages.explanation: The live reviewer grant is now revoked; the quarantined R4 copy retains its earlier historical state.

stages.label: full-inspection-and-restore-with-all-source-paths-unavailable
stages.explanation: All three original workspace paths are temporarily renamed; the full bundle still inspects and restores complete quarantined history.

stages.label: restored-point-in-time-records-remain-quarantined
stages.explanation: The restored current DB retains R4 content, dependencies, tasks, events and receipts; live R5 and the later revocation remain separate.

stages.label: restored-authority-and-format-boundaries
stages.explanation: Current credentials cannot turn historical copied rows into writes, publication, backup authority or transfer authority.

stages.label: complete-history-remains-stable-after-live-continuation
stages.explanation: Repeated full inspection preserves the captured identity, both archives and quarantined restore while the original source stays active at R5.

limits: The complete backup remains a private inspection bundle; restoring it never activates old runtime authority or renews leases.
Only the original live source performs fresh author work and a new acceptance. Its later revocation is separate from historical copied grant state.
Source-path unavailability is a reversible rename of three private directories with finally restoration, not a process or hardware crash.
The full bundle verifier checks all ancestral archives; the ordinary database-only inspector retains its separate exact layout contract.
Public equality omits only the changing top-level governance observed_at wrapper. Expired flags and full addressed proof bodies remain intact.
Declared dependency provenance is preserved. Query maps in the fictional source are empty; no separate stale read/query case is induced here.
Incomplete bundle points, concurrent source policy changes, byte corruption and input-limit exhaustion are not simulated by this ordinary scenario.
Programmed local roles do not establish independent human or model expertise, factual truth, external fencing or measured production capacity.
